title: Azure SQL Query Performance and Scaling
description: Monitor query performance, use intelligent insights, and scale Azure SQL Database compute and storage.

data.text: Azure SQL Database includes built-in monitoring and automatic tuning to help you maintain query performance as workloads change. You can scale compute up or down, use serverless auto-pause, and apply intelligent recommendations without being a DBA.

data.title: Built-in Monitoring
items: **Query Performance Insight** — visualizes top resource-consuming queries by CPU, DTU, or vCore.
**SQL Analytics** — Azure Monitor-based views for waits, timeouts, and failed connections.
**Dynamic Management Views (DMVs)** — sys.dm_db_resource_stats, sys.dm_exec_query_stats, and more.
**Intelligent Insights** — AI-driven detection of performance regressions with root-cause analysis.

data.title: Find Top Queries with DMV
data.content: Identify the most CPU-intensive queries in Azure SQL
data.code:
SELECT TOP 10
  qs.execution_count,
  qs.total_worker_time / qs.execution_count AS avg_cpu_ms,
  SUBSTRING(qt.text, (qs.statement_start_offset / 2) + 1,
    (CASE qs.statement_end_offset
      WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(qt.text)
      ELSE qs.statement_end_offset
    END - qs.statement_start_offset) / 2 + 1) AS query_text
FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats AS qs
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(qs.sql_handle) AS qt
ORDER BY qs.total_worker_time DESC;

data.text: With provisioned compute, you can change the vCore count or DTU level with zero downtime. With serverless, compute auto-scales within a defined range and pauses when idle. Choose serverless for intermittent workloads and provisioned for steady, predictable loads.

data.title: Scale Compute with Azure CLI
data.content: Increase the vCore count of a provisioned database
data.code:
az sql db update \
  --resource-group rg-demo \
  --server sqlserver-demo \
  --name AppDb \
  --compute-model Provisioned \
  --capacity 4

terms.definition: Azure SQL's built-in feature that detects performance regressions and suggests fixes automatically.
A feature that applies index creation, index removal, and query plan corrections automatically.
A compute tier that auto-scales and pauses during inactivity to reduce cost.
A fixed compute tier with guaranteed resources and predictable performance.

data.title: Enable Automatic Tuning
data.text: Turn on CREATE_INDEX, DROP_INDEX, and FORCE_LAST_GOOD_PLAN in the Azure Portal. Azure SQL will test and apply tuning recommendations in a safe, reversible way.

data.title: Exercise: Diagnose and Scale
data.description: Monitor a database under load and adjust compute to handle it.
steps: Create a provisioned database at a low compute tier.
Run a CPU-heavy query and watch the CPU percentage in Query Performance Insight.
Note the DTU or vCore usage and the query execution time.
Scale the database to a higher compute tier.
Rerun the query and compare the execution time.
data.expectedOutcome: Measurable improvement in query performance after increasing compute.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use Query Performance Insight and DMVs to identify slow queries.
Intelligent Insights and automatic tuning provide hands-off optimization.
Provisioned compute gives predictable performance; serverless saves money for variable loads.
Scaling compute is fast and requires no downtime.
data.takeaway: Azure SQL gives you powerful performance tools without requiring deep DBA expertise.
